svg.text: Tower B · Learning Center · Levels 00–04 on the one-bar radial-grid plan

18 columns at r 13.7 m on a 20° grid and the 47° bridge axis are from the model; core 9 m, central lobby to r 7 m, one bar r 8–12.6 m on the bridge side with partitions on the radials, open floor to the forest, exterior stair 2 at the bar end. Schematic, 2 November 2026.
